about: What O2 (plan §2) holds ct-tpg322's finished stock to: every face of the STEP within physics.stock_deviation_mm, no face exempt and no band, but the zones below (read by moonshot/tests/gates/test_turned_ground_stock.py). Protected (plan §6, rule 1): an exemption added here is a decision, made visibly.
held: Every face of the STEP: the ground top and bottom (thickness .125 ±.001), the chipbreaker's land, groove walls and floor along each edge (drawing note 1, ground on the surface grinder), and the periphery (the 11 deg flanks and the 1/32 nose radii), which the blank must come with if no step grinds it.

zones.why: The user's decision (2026-11-06): the chipbreaker is ground by straight passes of the diamond slotting wheel along each edge (the shop's surface-grinder routing, plan ct-tpg322), which can't follow the groove round the nose, so the top within 2.9 mm of each sharp vertex along its edge is exempt as what a straight wheel leaves: each edge's groove floor is held over the 10.7 of its 16.5 mm (2.9 to 13.6 mm) the wheel reaches. The top only: the land, the groove's floor, walls and corners, and the plateau (z 2.972 and up), never the flanks, the nose radii or the bottom.

zones_why: A zone exempts the samples on the top within along_mm of a sharp vertex, measured along the vertex's nearer edge (moonshot/tests/gates/test_turned_ground_stock.py in_zones), not whole faces: the groove's floor and walls along the middle of each edge stay held.
